items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: they had already booked Charlie Barnet to follow us

ctx.x: Yeah, then after a week or so they realized that we were a pretty good band, but they had already booked Charlie Barnet to follow us, so that would be the end of our 52nd Street career. But then by the same token, John Kirby
just opened at the Onxy Club; Stuff Smith -- Stuff Smith had opened the Onyx Club --
